fusion_policy: Fixed equal-weight RRF retaining original BM25/Dense channels plus constrained generator; no fusion tuning
coding: Recursive balanced median split on largest-variance catalog embedding coordinate; item-ID tie break; singleton zero padding to fixed depth; no query labels
training: Train-only grade>=1 positives, up to half cap per grade then fill remaining; seeded sampling without replacement per query; teacher-forced next-bit cross entropy; frozen MiniLM query encoder
selection: Full 96-query validation NDCG@10 at fixed full-catalog beam100; earliest epoch on exact ties; no test-based selection
budget_policy: Cooperative checks between batches/validation; no new epoch after elapsed budget; no hard process deadline
